description: Source code for a Skills Injection Hook in LiteLLM Proxy, managing skill processing, code execution, and response handling for different model types.

classes.name: SkillsInjectionHook
classes.description: A hook class for processing skills, executing code, and managing responses in LiteLLM Proxy.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-processing skills before LLM call, fetching skills from DB, converting to tools, injecting content.

methods.name: _process_for_messages_api
methods.description: Converts skills to Anthropic tools, injects skill content, adds code execution tools, manages metadata.

methods.name: _process_non_anthropic_model
methods.description: Converts skills to OpenAI tools, injects content, adds code execution, manages metadata.

methods.name: _fetch_skill_from_db
methods.description: Fetches a skill from the LiteLLM database asynchronously.

methods.name: _is_anthropic_model
methods.description: Determines if a model is an Anthropic model based on provider info.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_deployment_hook
methods.description: Post-processing after successful call, handling code execution loop if needed.

methods.name: _extract_tool_calls
methods.description: Extracts tool call information from response in different formats.

methods.name: _execute_code_loop_messages_api
methods.description: Executes code in a loop until final response, handling tool calls and generated files.

methods.name: _execute_code
methods.description: Executes code in sandbox environment, returns output and generated files.

methods.name: _execute_skill_tool
methods.description: Generates and runs code for a skill tool based on skill modules.

methods.name: _execute_code_loop
methods.description: Executes code in a loop for OpenAI format responses until completion.

methods.name: _execute_code_tool
methods.description: Executes a code tool call, manages generated files and output.

methods.name: _attach_files_to_response
methods.description: Attaches generated files to the response object for access.
